UC-WEB-001.decision: Client half of resumable Finish & Sign at the canonical orchestrator (useCaptureSessionOrchestration). A per-staged-set reservation keeps the evidenceId: a retry after a part failure reuses the SAME record (no second POST /v1/evidence), skips already-uploaded items, re-presigns only missing parts (parts route is RETURN_EXISTING per partIndex), and a failed /complete retries only /complete; the reservation is abandoned if items are removed/reordered so a part index is never re-bound to another file. The catch now resets every item's uploading/progress and marks the failing item with a safe error. Across a reload the server is the authority: lane A's POST /v1/evidence returns the draft's reserved unsealed record (resolveResumableDraftRecord, resumed:true) for the same captureSessionId, which the client always sends. No Idempotency-Key header is sent because the API CORS allow-list does not include it (it would break the cross-origin create). Offline: finalize refuses to start (nothing minted) and staged items are kept.
